description: Send a sticker via WhatsApp. The easy way: pass `sticker` as a mood or label (e.g. 'laughing', 'thumbs up', 'fire', 'celebrate') and a matching sticker is found automatically from the platform-wide community sticker library (falling back to this org's own stickers). Advanced: pass `stickerUrl` with a direct public WebP image URL instead. Provide one of the two. Only supported on Baileys channels.

sticker.description: Mood or label to auto-match a sticker (e.g. 'laughing', 'fire', 'celebrate'). Preferred over stickerUrl.

stickerUrl.description: Advanced: direct URL to a public WebP sticker image. Use only if no mood/label fits.

name: neuron_send_sticker
title: Send Sticker
